check_IsKeyword: check if a given token string is a C++ keyword using the IsKeyword function
check_IsBuiltinType: check if a given token string is a C++ builtin type using the IsBuiltinType function
inspect_TYPES: inspect the TYPES set to see all C++ primitive type keywords like int, float, and void
inspect_TYPE_MODIFIERS: inspect the TYPE_MODIFIERS set to see all C++ type modifier keywords like const, static, and volatile
inspect_ALL: inspect the ALL set to see the complete union of all C++ keyword categories
